faqs.a:
Section 302.1. Sanitation,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
302.1. Sanitation.
All exterior property and premises shall be maintained in a clean, safe and sanitary
                  condition. The occupant shall keep that part of the exterior property which such occupant
                  occupies or controls in a clean and sanitary condition, in compliance with this code."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
